as_told.title: Travis Walton's return with a full beard

plain: A researcher, Mike Masters, who argues that aliens may be humans from the future, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about Travis Walton, a man who says he was abducted by a UFO in Arizona in 1975. Masters says Walton had shaved right before the experience but woke up afterwards with a full beard. If true, it would suggest far more time passed for Walton than for the world around him.
